about: A limited Nicaraguan puro from Warped that combines elements of its Sky Flower and Moon Garden blends, made by AGANORSA Leaf in Esteli. It comes in one corona size with a rounded 109-style head.
notes: Limited to 500 boxes of 50. No maker strength is published; the strength here comes from halfwheel's review, which found it mild to just under medium.

about: A limited Warped release whose blend and size were chosen by a vote of retailers who smoked three test blends. It is made at Tabacalera La Isla in the Dominican Republic and was sold through only 12 shops.
notes: Limited to 1,000 boxes of 15. The official size is 5 7/8 x 52; Neptune lists it as a 6 x 52 toro. No maker strength is published: halfwheel and Neptune say medium, Atlantic Cigar says medium-full.
verifyNotes: Blend, factory, size and release confirmed on halfwheel. Added the retailer strength split to notes (Neptune Medium, Atlantic Medium-Full) and swapped the duplicate halfwheel news link for the Atlantic page.

filler: Nicaragua (Esteli Criollo 98, Jalapa Corojo 99, Condega Corojo 99)
about: A limited Nicaraguan puro from Warped built on AGANORSA tobacco from Esteli, Jalapa and Condega, with Esteli criollo 98 as the main filler leaf. It was sold only in numbered 200-count boxes.
notes: Limited to 250 numbered boxes of 200 cigars. No maker strength is published; strength and body come from halfwheel's review.

about: A Warped line that began as an exclusive for DROP Cigar Club, Kyle Gellis's own shop. The store release, Seleccion de Capital, is a box-pressed toro with a Mexican San Andres wrapper over AGANORSA Nicaraguan tobacco.
notes: Details are for Seleccion de Capital, the store release: 500 boxes of 25 in 2023 and again in 2024. Strength is from Warped calling it full bodied. The earlier DROP-only Bits of Havana Robusto (5 x 48) is a different blend, a medium Nicaraguan puro with a Corojo 99 wrapper.
verifyNotes: Cleared flavors: none of the listed pages give tasting notes for Seleccion de Capital. Strength Full rests only on the press release wording "full bodied" (Cigar Dojo); said so in notes.

about: A three-part Warped series with one blend from each factory the company works with: El Titan de Bronze, Tabacalera La Isla and AGANORSA. The 4546, made at La Isla with a Dominican corojo wrapper, is the one that went to stores.
notes: Details are for the Seleccion Domain 4546 (red band), which shipped to stores in March 2023. The series has three different blends by band color: green from El Titan de Bronze (sold through DROP Cigar Club in 2022), red from La Isla, black from AGANORSA. Strength is from Cigar Aficionado.

wrapperLeaf: Barber pole of Connecticut Broadleaf and Ecuadorian Desflorada
about: An event-only Warped cigar whose name is short for Radioactive Waste. It is a box-pressed torpedo with two wrappers rolled in a barber pole pattern, made at NACSA in Nicaragua.
notes: Sold only in three-pack boxes at Warped events. It has two wrappers (dark broadleaf and lighter Ecuadorian leaf), so no single wrapper category applies. No strength or tasting notes are published.

about: An early Gellis Family Cigars release from Warped founder Kyle Gellis, sold through his DROP Cigar Club shop in boxes of 10. It has a closed foot, a Dominican corojo wrapper, and a year of cedar aging after being rolled in 2022.
notes: Sold only through Kyle Gellis's DROP Cigar Club shop, in boxes of 10, and now sold out. The shop lists strength as Medium+. Gellis Family Cigars is a separate brand, distributed by Warped.
verifyNotes: Single source (the DROP listing); every blend field matches it. Released 2023 is not stated outright: the page says rolled in 2022 and aged one year, and the listing went live in September 2023. Trimmed research-diary wording from notes.
